title: 第307章 有什么可惜的第306章 走了啊
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: “甲板上那些菜箱还好着呢。
搬回来正好放院子里种东西。”
苏璃看了她一眼。
“不觉得可惜？”
“有什么可惜的。”
赛娜把萝卜干翻了个面，“船又不会跑，搬回来的东西还能接着用。
比扔在那儿生锈强。”
第二天一早，四个人去了港口。
苏璃把甲板上的菜箱一个个卸下来，连同里面板结的旧土一起搬到推车上。
艾洛诺儿拆走了还能用的防风回路铜片。
伊莲娜负责指挥。
她拄着手杖站在码头上，手里攥着一份物品清单。
“厨房那套战斗固定架留着，拆回去当晾衣杆用。”
“那玩意死沉。”
苏璃扛着一口铁锅从船舱里出来。
“沉就多走两趟。”
伊莲娜在清单上打了个勾。
赛娜把船舱角落里翻出来的旧围裙卷起来，闻了闻。
是当年她在船上做饭时用的那条，油渍洗不掉了，但布料还结实。
她把围裙叠好放进背篓里。
搬了整两天。
最后伊莲娜雇了几个工人，用巨型油布把银杏号从头到尾罩了起来。
灰绿色的帆布盖住了桅杆、船舷和那面已经褪色的银杏叶船徽。
当天傍晚下了场大雨。
苏璃站在屋檐下，看着港口方向。
雨幕里，银杏号的轮廓像一座小山，油布被雨水打得啪啪响。
曾经的五阶远洋船。
曾经说好要带赛娜去看的南方大海。
曾经花了十年造，又花了二十年养护的梦。
现在成了港口里一堆裹着油布的废铁。
苏璃看了好一会儿。
雨水顺着屋檐滴下来，打在他脚边的石板上。
“进来吧。”
赛娜的声音从身后传来，“汤热好了。”
content_en:
"Those vegetable boxes on the deck are still fine.
I moved it back just in time to plant things in the yard. "
Su Li glanced at her.
"Don't you think it's a pity?"
"What a pity."
Saina turned the dried radish over and said, "The ship won't run away, and the things brought back can still be used.
Better than leaving it there to rust. "
Early the next morning, the four people went to the port.
Su Li unloaded the vegetable boxes on the deck one by one and moved them to the cart along with the old soil inside.
Elonelle removed the copper piece of the windproof circuit that was still usable.
Elena is in charge.
She stood on the dock leaning on her cane, clutching a list of belongings.
"Keep the fighting rack in the kitchen and take it apart to use it as a clothes drying rod."
"That thing is dead heavy."
Su Li came out of the cabin carrying an iron pot.
"Shen, just go two more times."
Jelena checked off the list.
Senna rolled up an old apron that had been found in the corner of the cabin and smelled it.
It was the one she used when cooking on the boat. The oil stains couldn't be washed away, but the fabric was still strong.
She folded her apron and put it in her carrier.
It took two days to move.
In the end, Elena hired a few workers to cover the Ginkgo from head to tail with giant oilcloth.
The gray-green canvas covered the mast, the ship's side and the faded ginkgo leaf emblem.
It rained heavily that evening.
Su Li stood under the eaves and looked towards the port.
In the rain curtain, the outline of the Ginkgo looked like a hill, and the oilcloth was pattering with rain.
A former fifth-tier ocean-going ship.
I once promised to take Senna to see the southern sea.
A dream that took ten years to create and twenty years to maintain.
It is now a pile of scrap metal wrapped in tarpaulin in the harbor.
Su Li looked at it for a long time.
Rain dripped down the eaves and hit the stone slabs at his feet.
"Come in."
Senna's voice came from behind, "The soup is hot."
